structure.unit: Drainage, Soil Conservation, Sanitation and Public Facilities Districts

law.catch_line: Public facilities district law for certain counties
law.text: Chapter 93 of the Acts of 1946, as amended by Chapter 363 of Acts 1952, relating to public facilities district law applicable in counties having a population of between 500 and 1,000 inhabitants per square mile and a land area of between thirty and seventy square miles, or of any county having a land area of between thirty and eighty-five square miles, is continued in effect.
